text:
You will rain in the rainy season,

you will bring heat in summer,

you will bring cold at dusk.

You will die again a thousand times.


You will bloom when everything blooms.

You are nothing, no one, Mother.


The same trace will remain of us,

the seed of the wind in water,

the skeleton of leaves in the earth.

On the rocks, the tattoo of shadows,

in the heart of the trees the word love.


We are nothing, no one, Mother.

It is useless to live,

but it is more useless to die.

translation.title: Doña Luz XVII
